summary.text: Susan Frantz is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 78, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Cindy Banyai; there is no incumbent in the race.
Frantz won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary with 71.0 percent of the vote over Audrey Brooks.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Associated Industries of Florida, the Florida Chamber of Commerce and Florida Realtors PAC among the organizations that endorsed Susan Frantz in 2026.
